notes.title: PATCH V1.2.10
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello!!!!![/h2]
First of all we would like to say many thanks to all of the incredible support that we have received since the games release :) All of the feedback has been astonishing and we are happy that so many people are enjoying our little game! [b]Thank you![/b] For this update we used your feedback and have added many things that were heavily requested by you guys. On top of that we are doing a [b]20% discount from the 5th-12th of august![/b] So this is the perfect time to [b]invite your friends[/b]!

Finally, we would also want to thank all of the [b]Content Creators[/b] who have been playing our game. It has been incredibly fun to both watch the videos and streams and also to read all of the comments :) Many many thanks![/b]

[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]
[list]
[*]A server browser has been added to the menu that allows finding public lobbies of other players.
[*]An option has been added to change the visibility of your lobby between: [i]Private[/i], [i]Friends Only[/i] and [i]Public[/i]. This setting is set to [i]Friends Only[/i] by default.
[/list]
[h2]Items[/h2]
Two new items have been added to the item-pool. These include the Claw and the Circuit Board.
[h3]Claw[/h3]
The Claw allows the player to steal other players items.
[list]
[*][b]Red/Black: [/b] Steal an item off of a random player.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Steal an item off of each player.[/list]
[h3]Circuit Board[/h3]
Makes the player gain additional turns.
[list]
[*][b]Red/Black: [/b] Gain one additional turn.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Gain two additional turns
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow players to click the confirm button multiple times in some rare scenarios.
[*]Fixed button click animations for clients
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the game not to load for one person, if the start game button was pressed right after somebody joined.
[*]Item descriptions have been made more readable.
[*]Minor Localization Fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.1.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi![/h3]
This patch primarily focuses on improvements for the Hourglass Item. But also fixes some bugs.
Once again many thanks for all the positive reviews and useful feedback :)

[h3]HOURGLASS[/h3]
The Hourglass was useless whenever only two people were left in a game. To improve this we introduced the following changes:
[list]
[*]If only two people are left alive in a game, the hourglass now makes the player gain an extra turn.
[*]This also means that the hourglass is now once again available in two player mode.
[/list]
[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the Mouse Sensitivity Slider to visually be maxed out by default.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.1.1

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: PATCH V1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

Before we get to the patch notes, we wanted to say that we are incredibly thankful for all the great reviews, community posts and general feedback we have received from you guys so far. [b]Thank you very much![/b] We would have never expected all of this positive support and are incredibly happy that everyone is enjoying the game!

With all that being said here are the patch notes for Version 1.1.0:

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
The following Achievements have now been added to the game:
[list]
[*][b]CASHOUT[/b] - Win a game.
[*][b]FLAWLESS [/b]- Win a game with full Health.
[*][b]BEGINNER'S LUCK[/b] - Successfully bet an item 5 times in a row.
[*][b]0.28%[/b] - Hit green two times in a row.
[*][b]0.014579384%[/b] - Hit green three times in a row. [b](I like those odds)[/b]
[*][b]OVERKILL[/b] - Deal more damage than your opponent has health.
[*][b]ONE SHOT[/b] - Kill an enemy with full health in a single blow.
[*][b]CLOSE CALL[/b] - Win with one health remaining.
[*][b]UNLUCKY [/b]- Miss five shots in a row.
[*][b]BACK FROM THE DEAD[/b] - Heal from one to full health at once.
[*][b]AGAINST ALL ODDS[/b] - At one health, survive four attacks.
[*][b]GAMBLER'S FALLACY[/b] - Complete all achievements.
[/list]
To all of you completionists, we wish the best of luck! Some of the achievements might be near impossible but we would love to be proven otherwise!

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a Zoom-Function. Can be triggered by right-clicking or with the right shoulder button on a gamepad.
[*]Made Item Name and Description more legible
[*]Removed the Hourglass-Item from the Item Pool if playing with only two players, as it was useless.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH V1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everybody :)

This is just a small patch, but we wanted to use the opportunity to say [b]thank you[/b] to all of you. The feedback has been incredible and we are so happy that all of you are enjoying the game!

We will release a larger update either later today or tomorrow, so stay tuned for that.

Once again [b]thank you very much![/b]
